full_judgment:
4.  The suit of the opposite party No.1 plaintiff in short is that the suit land is situated at Mouja Kustia under Sadar Upazilla, District Mymensingh the CS Plot No. 684 was originally belonged to one late Naimuddin, the father of petitioner No. 1 and 2 and one Zinnat Ali who became the owner and possessor of the suit land by inheritance from their ancestral, and by purchase Zinnat Ali transferred 3 decimals of land to the plaintiff and on 22-7-1975 vide registered deed No. 22683 Naimuddin transferred 6.50 decimals of land vide registered deed No. 15620 to plaintiff dated 22-10-1975. Since purchase plaintiff planted 60 betel nut trees, their age is 7 years and before 3/4 years planted 4 mango trees, four jackfruit trees, two Jamrul trees, one Amra tree, all these are available there, defendants are trying to enter into the suit premises and to destroy those. Due to car accident the husband of the plaintiff was sentenced and was in jail hajat and the plaintiff was in bed ridden. On 1st Shraban 1397 BS Mojibur Rahman and Mofazzal erected a tin shed house and others defendants erected four katcha house (Chaner Ghar). The defendants erected those houses forcefully. So the plaintiff instituted suit for declaration and to evict the defendants and to deliver the possession of the suit land to plaintiff. 5. The defendant No. 1, 2 and 3 filed a written statement and defendant No.4 now the petitioner No.3 also filed a separate written statement denying the contention made in the plaint and defendant No.4 now the petitioner No.3 stated in his written statement that on 25-2-1976 vide registered deed serial No. 3636 and deed No. 3643, his brother Mujibur Rahman purchased 4 decimals of land from CS Plot No. 684 corresponding to DP Khatian No. 1278 DP Plot No. 2891. The brother of the defendant No. 4 now the petitioner No. 3 erected a tin shed house and a katcha house (Chaner ghar) and by growing different kinds of trees have been enjoying its peaceful possession since purchase without interruption from any quarter, the plaintiff opposite party No. 1 never possessed the suit land just to grab the land of the defendant No.4 now petitioner No.3 has filed the false fabricated, cooked up and vexatious suit against the petitioner the plaintiff has no and had no right, title, interest and possession over the 4 decimals of land of the defendant. The suit of the plaintiff is liable to be dismissed. The suit property 4 decimals of land is a homestead and the brother of the defendant No. 4 i.e. petitioner No.3 has been living with family members by erecting tin shed and katcha ghar (Chaner Ghar) therein. 

 6. The defendant No.1 and 2 now the petitioner No.1 and 2 filed a written statement denying the contention of the plaint and stating that the suit property was originally belonged to their father Naimuddin and Naimuddin died, leaving behind his heirs this defendant and others. During the life time of Naimuddin they had been living in the suit land with family members as homestead. Naimuddin did not transfer 6.50 decimals of land from the suit plot to the plaintiff and no question arise regarding delivery of possession of the suit land to the plaintiff. After the death of Naimuddin after 13 or 15 years the plaintiff instituted the false and fabricated suit showing a false deed which was not executed and registered by Naimuddin in favour of the plaintiff. The so-called deed is fully denied by the defendant-petitioners. During DP Khatian operation the names of the defendants-petitioners were correctly recorded in DP Khatian.
